full_prompt_en: A square exuberant animated-film illustration shows a lone dark-haired boy standing near the center of a crowded city street while a dreamlike giant pale figure rises among the clouds above him. The boy is front-facing in a teal short-sleeved shirt and trousers, small and still amid many loosely painted people moving in different directions. The lower half is filled with warm, busy fragments of bodies, shopfronts, poles, signs, and architectural pieces, all compressed into a richly colored urban texture. Behind the crowd, a fairground-like wheel and layered buildings climb toward the middle. The upper half opens into a vivid turquoise sky crowded with peach-edged clouds, flying fish or whale-like shapes, small birds, and floating objects. A huge white-haired face and shoulders appear near the top center, as if made of cloud and light, looking toward the left. This surreal figure is much larger than the city yet blends into the sky rather than casting a shadow on it. Brushwork is loose and animated: small angled strokes pile up in the crowd, cloud edges break into warm pastel patches, and the sky uses broad blue-green swaths. The palette mixes turquoise and cobalt with coral, peach, sandy ochre, and cream, creating many warm-cool collisions. There is no single photographic light source. Bright daylight fills the sky and catches cloud rims, while the street is slightly darker but still saturated with reflected color. The central boy remains relatively simple and dark, making him a visual pause inside the motion. The composition feels expansive, joyful, and disorienting, connecting human scale below to impossible scale above through a dense middle layer of color and movement.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形热烈动画电影插画呈现一名深发男孩站在拥挤城市街道中央附近，头顶云层间升起梦境般的巨大浅色人物。男孩正面朝前，穿青绿短袖衫与长裤，在许多朝不同方向移动、以松散笔触绘出的人群中显得小而静止。下半部充满暖色繁忙的身体、店面、杆件、标志和建筑片段，压缩成色彩丰厚的都市纹理。人群后面，一只游乐园般的轮子与层叠楼房向中部攀升。上半部打开成鲜明青绿天空，挤满带桃色边的云、飞行的鱼或鲸样形体、小鸟与漂浮物。巨大白发面孔和肩部在顶部中央附近显出，像由云和光构成，望向左侧。这一超现实形体远比城市大，却融入天空，而不在其上投影。笔触松动而有动画感：人群里小斜笔层层堆积，云缘破成暖粉彩片，天空用宽阔蓝绿扫笔。配色把青绿、钴蓝与珊瑚、桃色、沙赭和奶油混合，产生许多暖冷碰撞。没有单一摄影光源。明亮白日光填满天空、抓住云边，街道稍暗却仍充满反射色。中央男孩相对简洁而深暗，成为运动中的视觉停顿。构图辽阔、欢悦而令人目眩，经由密集色彩和运动的中层，将下方人的尺度连接到上方不可能的尺度。
style_prompt_en: An exuberant hand-painted animation treatment contrasts a relatively simple dark central vertical with an extremely busy lower field and a vast surreal upper field. Turquoise and cobalt blue occupy broad open areas, while peach, coral, cream, and sandy ochre break them into cloudlike curls and many small warm fragments. The middle is dense with loose, angled strokes and overlapping miniature shapes; the upper region features larger soft-edged masses and occasional floating dark marks. Scale is deliberately elastic, with one pale oversized upper form balanced by a small grounded dark accent below. Edges vary from sketchy, fragmented crowdlike texture to luminous blended passages in the sky. Daylight is broad and painterly rather than physically exact, catching warm rims and allowing saturated color to persist in shadow. The visual rhythm is crowded, swirling, and upward-moving, while the comparatively still center keeps the energetic image readable.
style_prompt_zh: 热烈手绘动画处理把相对简单的深色中央竖线，与极繁忙下部色域和广大超现实上部色域对照。青绿与钴蓝占据宽阔开放区域，桃色、珊瑚、奶油和沙赭把它们打碎成云状卷团与许多暖色小片。中部由松动斜笔与叠压微小形状密密构成；上部则出现更大柔边体块与零星漂浮深暗记号。尺度有意富于弹性，上方一块巨大浅色形体由下方贴地的小深暗点缀平衡。边缘在草绘、破碎的人群般纹理与天空中发亮的混合片段之间变化。日光宽广而绘画性强，并非物理上精确；它抓住暖边，让暗部仍有饱和色。视觉节奏拥挤、旋转且向上移动，而相对静止的中心维持热闹图像的可读性。
theme_en: A lone boy in a crowded city beneath a dreamlike giant in the clouds and airborne sea creatures
theme_zh: 拥挤城市里一名独立男孩，头顶云中巨像与飞翔海兽
name: Masaaki Yuasa
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
